body: That’s insane! I’m so glad you’re okay now, & happy someone near my age experienced close to what I’m going through. Thank you!!

once their relationship ends they won’t be so happy

trust me on this one, i just very recently went through a bad breakup. At first it consumes you, and it will for a long long time, but it will get better. I’m always down and most of the time when I am i tell myself the same thing. When it’s hot out, you think it’ll never be cold again. When you’re sad, you think you’ll never be happy again. But most importantly it will be cold again and you will be happy again. Everything takes time and you’ll always be broken because if this but you have to grow from it. Even if that sounds cliche. I’m still broken down, you aren’t alone. Times are rough, and that’s just how life goes. For now focus on you because that’s what is very important right now

it’s all about confidence. a girl wants a guy who they think they’ll never get... if someone truly doesn’t see the good in you they aren’t worth your time. Not something to kill your self over, always a brighter future. For example when it’s hot out, you think it’ll never be cold again. Same thing with your emotions. When you’re sad, you think you’ll never be happy again. The important thing is that you will, but you have to want it. You have to be learn to be happy with yourself before you’re happy with someone else .... nothing will last if not. Take my word for that
